LESSON: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: General
Strand: PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS Strand Sub strand Specific Learning 
Topic 2.2: Population distribution in Eastern Africa
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Population distribution in Eastern Africa, part of PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS Strand Sub strand Specific Learning  in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: Why are some parts of Eastern Africa more populated than others?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Population distribution in Eastern Africa together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
